title: Basin-lake family-care migrant foundational body plan
scope: Foundational body plan, locomotor structures, and mobile-refuge care interface for the family-care migrant governed by WLD-ECOLOGY-006; usable within shared-setting ecology, organism design, migration planning, and story development.
claims: The family-care migrant's established caregiving migratory form has a low living body organised as a three-lobed, broadly tri-radial vault.
A ring of short hydrostatic paddle-columns forms part of its locomotor structure.

Travelling waves move along the body margin and contribute to locomotion; their general mechanical relationship to the paddle-columns remains undefined outside the bounded outlet-passage choreography later governed by WLD-ECOLOGY-010.
The underside of the living vault forms a refuge that moves with the caregiving form.
Mobile young shelter beneath the vault, spill outward to forage, and regroup beneath the refuge.
boundaries: This record governs the family-care migrant's established caregiving migratory form only. Juvenile morphology and all other life-stage anatomy remain undefined.

Brood-Vault Strider, living vault, tri-radial, hydrostatic paddle-column, and mobile refuge are author-facing functional or editorial descriptions, not in-world names, formal taxonomy, or Earth homologies.

Three-lobed or broadly tri-radial describes the qualitative vault shape only. It establishes no perfect symmetry, fixed angles, three paddle fields, repeated internal organs, three identities, or juvenile morphology.

Ring and short are qualitative. Exact paddle-column number, spacing, dimensions, orientation, pressure source, internal fluid, chambering, fibres, valves, muscles, stiffness, control, repair, and failure remain undefined.
Paddle-column establishes a living locomotor structure, not an Earth leg or fin homology, substrate walking, rowing efficiency, hovering, climbing, terrestrial movement, or overland bypass.

Travelling margin waves establish local tissue motion that contributes to locomotion, not environmental waves, Mana pulses, sonar, telepathy, aura, group control, or a specialised ability. WLD-ECOLOGY-010 later establishes only a bounded outlet-passage sequence linking a margin wave, successive paddle-column bracing, and a short advance; all other mechanical relationships remain undefined.

The underside refuge moves with the caregiving form but is not established as a shell, mineral armour, built nest, womb, sealed pouch, protected water pocket, fortification, invulnerable enclosure, or predator-proof space.

Shelter, outward foraging, and regrouping establish no permanent carriage, physical attachment, guaranteed return after every excursion, provisioning, guarding, retrieval, signalling, escort formation, carer number or sex, genetic kinship, or brood size.

The selected option carries a qualitative high-drag and route-feasibility concern. WLD-ECOLOGY-010 later governs a bounded margin-ratchet passage choreography, and WLD-GEOGRAPHY-002 later supplies a qualitative mixed outlet sequence of candidate contact surfaces and holding pockets. None of these records establishes measured drag, a continuous compatible bed-or-margin chain, passable shallows, bottom walking, bottom resting, quantitative outlet profile, route depth, substrate continuity, seasonal hydraulics, salinity profile, guaranteed low-velocity holding water, speed, endurance, homing, passage success, survival, or guaranteed return.

WLD-ECOLOGY-006 continues to govern seasonal arrival, one-warm-season care, the juvenile prey relationship, competition, predation and harvest, escorted seaward departure, mortality, recruitment, and population variability.
The family-care form does not inherit the mass breeder's WLD-ECOLOGY-007 anatomy, WLD-ECOLOGY-008 osmoregulation and buoyancy strategy, or ordinary Mana-supported tissue-reinforcement boundary.

Reproduction, birth or hatching, early immobile stages, carers, sexes, kinship, brood size, adult diet, provisioning, guarding, retrieval, signalling, refuge use during travel, and escort formation remain undefined.

Buoyancy, osmoregulation, respiratory medium and chemistry, exchange and internal transport, salinity tolerance, quantitative outlet profile and passability, passage mechanics beyond WLD-ECOLOGY-010, speed, endurance, fatigue, and all juvenile physiology remain undefined.
No reserve-web or other named-flora relationship is established.

Mana source, carrier, storage, circulation, tissue effects, capacity, cost, recovery, and failure remain undefined, as do specialised abilities, cognition, sapience, formal Skills, classes, levels, appraisal, and cultural or character knowledge.

Finite matter or material and usable-energy inputs, internal transport, heat and waste handling, maintenance, injury, disease, recovery, repair, reproduction, route capacity, mortality, and carrying capacity remain binding ecological constraints.

No pooled family identity, shared level or XP, automatic prey-power transfer, Skill, class, reward, System spawning, reset, refill, loot rule, free energy, or guaranteed population recovery is established.
story_implications: The family-care migrant can appear as a low alien vault whose mobile young shelter beneath it, move outward to feed, and regroup, creating directly observable care behaviour without disclosing hidden physiology or social rules; WLD-ECOLOGY-010 later adds an observable settle–ripple–brace–surge–settle outlet rhythm.

Its approved high-drag concern makes route geometry, water depth, current, body condition, and resting opportunities plausible future gates, but no exact track, posture, failure, route, or passage outcome is established.

An observer may see silhouette, travelling margin motion, the visible paddle-column ring, sheltering, outward foraging, regrouping, injury, or distress when conditions permit, but internal anatomy, motives, kinship, Mana state, and migration mechanism require evidence.
Author-side knowledge of the body plan and care pattern does not become automatic protagonist knowledge; each recognition and inference requires a source and bounded confidence.
system_implications: The selected body and care pattern are ordinary world inputs under CAL0 WLD1.1D, WLD1.2D, and WLD2.1A+D, not a System change.
A caregiving form, refuge, brood, or family group does not gain pooled System identity, levels, XP, Skills, classes, or rewards merely through shelter, coordination, or proximity.
Predation transfers no automatic XP, attributes, traits, Skills, Mana, levels, or power; any later material or magical effect requires its own mechanism and Author gate.

Hydrostatic support and travelling tissue waves require ordinary finite anatomy, matter, internal pressure, usable energy, control, internal transport, heat and waste handling, maintenance, recovery, and repair; they create no activated ability, free energy, spawn, reset, refill, or guaranteed recovery.
research_questions: What exact anatomy, pressure source, actuation, control, spacing, gait, and failure modes govern the paddle-columns and travelling margin waves outside the bounded passage sequence selected by WLD-ECOLOGY-010?

What body size, drag, contact fit, depth, current, body condition, usable-energy budget, and support-and-pause continuity can make the WLD-ECOLOGY-010 passage sequence viable within WLD-GEOGRAPHY-002's mixed outlet sequence during spring arrival and pre-freeze seaward departure?
How is the mobile refuge ventilated, what capacity and protection does it provide, and how does its use affect adult feeding, movement, condition, and mortality?
What cues, distances, timing, predation risk, and communication govern outward juvenile foraging and regrouping without guaranteeing return?
What reproduction, carer structure, kinship, brood size, provisioning, guarding, retrieval, signalling, and escort formation govern the family-care strategy?
What adult and juvenile feeding, respiration, circulation, osmoregulation, buoyancy, salinity tolerance, disease, and developmental mechanisms make the life cycle viable?
What Mana pathway and System-eligible functions, if any, later develop without replacing ordinary inputs or creating pooled family progression?
What external signs can people actually observe, what do they call or infer about the migrants, and what harvesting, risk-management, material use, belief, or misunderstanding later develops?

author_approval.evidence: After three complete visual body-plan cards were displayed and chat confirmation was required, the Author replied 'A' on 2026-08-14, selecting 'A — Brood-Vault Strider'.
